checkpoint.kind: source-only freeze; no PowerShell retirement or integrated parity claim
checkpoint.hash_encoding: UTF-8 text, leading UTF-8 BOM removed, CRLF normalized to LF; function extents exclude trailing newline

source_revision.kind: reviewed two-line native text-scalar correction; no dispatch or gate change
source_revision.metadata_correction: Include l5 in the existing top-level CLI JSON capture list; no production source change for this correction.

native_python_transport.scope: Cold native execution uses Python/C#; existing pipe and hot-cache ordering retained; all 109 clauses and safety gates unchanged.

helper_python_transport.scope: Default read-only service lifecycle/client delegates to Python/C#; staged lock and authority remain isolated; legacy login shims remain for later migration.

default_autostart_python.scope: Default autostart and version acquisition; no macro dispatch, consent or workflow gate change.
default_autostart_python.empty_diagnostic_argv: Normalize only absent arguments to an empty string array; retain all supplied tokens and immutable authority.

native_macro_python.scope: Seventeen prepare/report bodies in Python; existing native helper, pipe/hot cache, macro dispatcher and consent remain. Post-live reporting failures are uncertain and never replayed.

python_history.scope: Owned reads, append/rotation, statistics, lookback/frequency planning, show selection and clear are Python. Current PowerShell JSON/scalar facts, final linguistic tie comparisons and Console formatting remain in thin compatibility glue. Both PS5.1 and PS7 observed; no qualification-only C# reducer promoted.

python_coordinates.scope: Three read-only macros and Win32 coordinate builders now run through Python/C#. PS5 NLS/unstable ties and PS7 ICU/stable ties are startup dialects. Physical coordinate reads use one readonly worker per invocation; batch reuses the worker. Historical PS/C# math facade remains an immutable oracle, never a fallback.

python_hit_macros.scope: Hit argv/report preparation runs in Python. Fast hit retains readonly coordinate acquisition; other reads retain the default native helper pipe/hot-cache path. No input capability, dispatch change or retry added.

python_public_surfaces.scope: Version report assembly and macro rendering plus safety text/macro inference now run in Python. Original version reads/lock acquisition and the qualified safety/syntax kernels remain. PS7 date-shaped generated_at remains text in production glue. Standalone safety macro is connected; version acquisition is still a separate pending owner cutover.

python_authorization.scope: Original CLI live and coordinate-observation predicates, priority and notices run in Python. Live permission is immutable startup authority and cannot be granted by command text or JSON. Names, dispatch and safety rules are unchanged.

python_node_capture.scope: Production Node capture uses Python literal argv, owned output files, timeout and process handles. Original shell JSON dialect and streaming remain thin compatibility code. Actual Node exit codes replace pinned PS5 lost-exit-handle results. No shell, action replay, private CLI publication or authority change.

python_app_profile_runtime.scope: Python owns bounded acquisition orchestration, preflight and single-write gates. Existing shell acquisition/history ports, PS JSON semantics, C# recipe evaluation and final rendering remain. Fixed startup history destination, no action or persistence retry.

semantics.matching: PowerShell default string switch: invariant-culture case-insensitive; no trim, underscore aliases, wildcard, or regex mode
semantics.selection: ordered first matching clause returns from Invoke-Macro; do not collapse duplicate clauses
semantics.authority: A record describes dispatch only; presence does not authorize effects or prove candidate availability. No arbitrary handler lookup and no modern registry substitution.
semantics.availability: retained means present in the production legacy route, not implemented by the candidate Python host; host-unavailable must remain distinct from the seven legacy not_implemented entries

clauses.name: registry

not_implemented.next_action: 다른 매크로로 대체하거나, 이 기능이 필요하면 별도 구현 요청. 'cucp macro' 로 사용 가능 목록 확인.
not_implemented.macro_spelling: fixed lowercase clause literal, not input spelling

unknown_macro.behavior: Write-Notice ERROR then throw Unknown macro with original input; top-level macro error mapper determines exit

direct_safety_order: read arity-aware standalone confirmation from original rest under immutable inherited ceiling
if not confirmed, classify concatenated sub/rest text and original macro name
if classification requires explicit confirmation, emit safety-block with exit 3

confirmation_contract.input: original invocation argv; option values and nested plan contents cannot grant consent
confirmation_contract.inherited_rule: if present it must be an immutable Constant bool true; false, malformed or non-constant restricts consent; true never grants consent without original standalone flag
confirmation_contract.live_rule: AllowLiveControl is separate; neither confirmation nor classification grants live authority
confirmation_contract.missing_runtime: fail closed; never infer confirmed from argv substrings or unavailable parser

direct_cli: reject missing observation before rejecting missing live authority
then select JSON capture or streaming route
execution_family: restrict by immutable inherited sensitive ceiling
copy original rest and startup context
pass only captured ceilings as fixed process switches
validate effect shape and ceilings before dispatch
mark potential state/live change before leaf action
no automatic retry after uncertain mutation
interaction_family: copy original rest and alias Boolean options
validate shared host family and operation
validate shared effect then closed interaction descriptor
diagnostics_family: copy context and original rest into new state with live=false and sensitive=false
validate shared host then closed diagnostic descriptor
child: reject effect live/sensitive beyond parent ceiling
supply immutable Constant sensitive ceiling through fixed bootstrap
bind inert argv through named CucpArgs; never construct arbitrary source
cdp_family: prepare selected action under startup AllowLiveControl
invoke native helper only when port open
retain mutation uncertainty after potentially live dispatch

coordinate_observation_gate.semantics: legacy case-insensitive token presence only; flag values not validated by this gate

top_level.version_return: null -> 0; arrays select last integer then cast; failed cast -> 0; catch -> 1
top_level.macro_return: null -> 0; arrays use last element only if integer else 0; scalar cast or 0
top_level.macro_catch_blocked_regex: AllowLiveControl|Live (desktop )?control|Live click|requires -AllowLiveControl|Coordinate-based act|requires --after|Label not found|affordance_id not found
top_level.streaming: node CliPath with unchanged bound argv; no modern registry fallback
